title: POST /v1/plan request
description: Sent after day-end. Asks for the town plan for `day`, the day about to start. The day that just ended may still be pending (not yet saved); the planner reads it so tomorrow can react to it, but nothing is committed by this call. Needs a world snapshot first (409 otherwise).

hearts.description: The farmer's friendship hearts with each NPC (0 to 10, up to 14 for a spouse), keyed by NPC name. The planner uses it to pick how open each character is with the farmer. Optional: an NPC left out is planned at 0 hearts, the guarded tier. The bridge does not send it yet.
